{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzsA9eKHCnxThs4rA1pt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01A2zbBxHqb8JCoZBveNSTiD","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r4/spmv/spmv.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: rowStart\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Block row partitioning: returns the first row owned by a rank. Rank r owns\n//   rows [rowStart(r), rowStart(r+1)). The first (dim % nprocs) ranks own one\n//   extra row, so rowStart(nprocs) == dim.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   rank: rank whose first row is requested (may equal nprocs)\n//   nprocs: number of MPI ranks\n//   dim: number of rows in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nindex_t rowStart(const int rank, const int nprocs, const index_t dim) {\n    const index_t r = static_cast<index_t>(rank);\n    const index_t p = static_cast<index_t>(nprocs);\n    return r * (dim / p) + std::min(r, dim % p);\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fillLocal\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Draws n random values from the same stream as fill(), but stores only the\n//   values with indices in [keepBegin, keepEnd). Lets each rank keep just its\n//   share of the non-zero values without storing the whole array.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   out: receives the kept values, in index order\n//   n: number of values drawn\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//   keepBegin: first index to keep\n//   keepEnd: one past the last index to keep\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fillLocal(std::vector<double>& out, const index_t n, const double maxVal,\n               const index_t keepBegin, const index_t keepEnd) {\n    out.reserve(keepEnd - keepBegin);\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double val = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n        if (i >= keepBegin && i < keepEnd) {\n            out.push_back(val);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank runs the full pass so that the row\n//   delimiters match the serial program, but only the column indices of rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are kept.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of this rank's rows; receives the\n//                  entries of rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) in order\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows (global);\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n,\n                      const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        const bool ownsRow = (i >= rowBegin && i < rowEnd);\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                if (ownsRow) {\n                    cols.push_back(j);\n                }\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//   rowOffset: global index of the first element (used when reporting)\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size,\n                   const index_t rowOffset) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i + rowOffset, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const Rank r owns\n//   rows [rowStart(r), rowStart(r+1)). The first (dim % nprocs) ranks own one\n//   extra row, so rowStart(nprocs) == dim.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   rank: rank whose first row is requested (may equal nprocs)\n//   nprocs: number of MPI ranks\n//   dim: number of rows in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nindex_t rowStart(const int rank, const int nprocs, const index_t dim) {\n    const index_t r = static_cast<index_t>(rank);\n    const index_t p = static_cast<index_t>(nprocs);\n    return r * (dim / p) + std::min(r, dim % p);\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fillLocal\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Draws n random values from the same stream as fill(), but stores only the\n//   values with indices in [keepBegin, keepEnd). The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank runs the full pass so that the row\n//   delimiters match the serial program, but only the column indices of rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are kept.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols: (global);\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n,\n                      const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01A2zbBxHqb8JCoZBveNSTiD","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Rank r owns\n//   rows [rowStart(r), rowStart(r+1)). The first (dim % nprocs) ranks own one\n//   extra row, so rowStart(nprocs) == dim.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   rank: rank whose first row is requested (may equal nprocs)\n//   nprocs: number of MPI ranks\n//   dim: number of rows in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nindex_t rowStart(const int rank, const int nprocs, const index_t dim) {\n    const index_t r = static_cast<index_t>(rank);\n    const index_t p = static_cast<index_t>(nprocs);\n    return r * (dim / p) + std::min(r, dim % p);\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fillLocal\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Draws n random values from the same stream as fill(), but stores only the\n//   values with indices in [keepBegin, keepEnd). Lets each rank keep just its\n//   share of the non-zero values without storing the whole array.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   out: receives the kept values, in index order\n//   n: number of values drawn\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//   keepBegin: first index to keep\n//   keepEnd: one past the last index to keep\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fillLocal(std::vector<double>& out, const index_t n, const double maxVal,\n               const index_t keepBegin, const index_t keepEnd) {\n    out.reserve(keepEnd - keepBegin);\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double val = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n        if (i >= keepBegin && i < keepEnd) {\n            out.push_back(val);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank runs the full pass so that the row\n//   delimiters match the serial program, but only the column indices of rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are kept.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of this rank's rows; receives the\n//                  entries of rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) in order\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows (global);\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n,\n                      const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        const bool ownsRow = (i >= rowBegin && i < rowEnd);\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                if (ownsRow) {\n                    cols.push_back(j);\n                }\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//   rowOffset: global index of the first element (used when reporting)\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size,\n                   const index_t rowOffset) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i + rowOffset, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i + rowOffset, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    // This rank owns rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) and the matching nonzeros\n    const index_t rowBegin = rowStart(rank, nprocs, numRows);\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowStart(rank + 1, nprocs, numRows);\n    const index_t localRows = rowEnd - rowBegin;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\",\n               nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n        printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", nprocs);\n        printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate the sparsity pattern exactly as the serial program does, keeping\n    // only the column indices of this rank's rows\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters (global)\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols;                        // Column indices (local)\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols, h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows, rowBegin, rowEnd);\n\n    // Local nonzeros are the contiguous range [nnzBegin, nnzEnd) of the global ordering\n    const index_t nnzBegin = h_rowDelimiters[rowBegin];\n    const index_t nnzEnd = h_rowDelimiters[rowEnd];\n    std::vector<index_t> h_localRowDelimiters(localRows + 1);  // Row delimiters (local)\n    for (index_t i = 0; i <= localRows; ++i) {\n        h_localRowDelimiters[i] = h_rowDelimiters[rowBegin + i] - nnzBegin;\n    }\n\n    // Values and the dense vector come from the default-seeded stream, which the\n    // serial program uses first (rand() starts as if srand(1) was called)\n    srand(1);\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector (replicated)\n    std::vector<double> h_val;                          // Non-zero values (local)\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fillLocal(h_val, nItems, maxVal, nnzBegin, nnzEnd);\n    std::vector<double> h_out(localRows);               // Output vector (local rows)\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution for the local rows\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0)      h_vec.data(), localRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation. Each rank works on its own rows and the\n    // dense vector is already replicated, so no communication is needed here.\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_localRowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), localRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    // The computation is only done when the slowest rank finishes\n    long localMs = duration.count();\n    long maxMs = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_LONG, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", maxMs);\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        const double avgTime = maxMs / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n\n        printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<int> counts(nprocs);\n        std::vector<int> displs(nprocs);\n        for (int r = 0; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n            const index_t begin = rowStart(r, nprocs, numRows);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rowStart(r + 1, nprocs, numRows) - begin);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(begin);\n        }\n        std::vector<double> h_fullOut(rank == 0 ? numRows : 0);\n        MPI_Gatherv(h_out.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    h_fullOut.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            print_results(h_fullOut, \"OutputVector\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        const int localValid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), localRows, rowBegin) ? The first (dim % nprocs) ranks own one\n//   extra row, so rowStart(nprocs) == dim.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   rank: rank whose first row is requested (may equal nprocs)\n//   nprocs: number of MPI ranks\n//   dim: number of rows in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nindex_t rowStart(const int rank, const int nprocs, const index_t dim) {\n    const index_t r = static_cast<index_t>(rank);\n    const index_t p = static_cast<index_t>(nprocs);\n    return r * (dim / p) + std::min(r, dim % p);\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fillLocal\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Draws n random values from the same stream as fill(), but stores only the\n//   values with indices in [keepBegin, keepEnd). Lets each rank keep just its\n//   share of the non-zero values without storing the whole array.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   out: receives the kept values, in index order\n//   n: number of values drawn\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//   keepBegin: first index to keep\n//   keepEnd: one past the last index to keep\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fillLocal(std::vector<double>& out, const index_t n, const double maxVal,\n               const index_t keepBegin, const index_t keepEnd) {\n    out.reserve(keepEnd - keepBegin);\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double val = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n        if (i >= keepBegin && i < keepEnd) {\n            out.push_back(val);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank runs the full pass so that the row\n//   delimiters match the serial program, but only the column indices of rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are kept.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols: rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n,\n                      const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        const bool ownsRow = (i >= rowBegin && i < rowEnd);\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                if (ownsRow) {\n %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i + rowOffset, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName)  }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    // This rank owns rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) and the matching nonzeros\n    const index_t rowBegin = rowStart(rank, nprocs, numRows);\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowStart(rank + 1, nprocs, numRows);\n    const index_t localRows = rowEnd - rowBegin;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\",\n               nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzsWZQ8F4mk2LhgmM2AT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The SpMV is now distributed across MPI ranks in `spmv/spmv.cpp`, and `spmv/CMakeLists.txt` requires MPI and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable is still `spmv`, and I created no new files in the repo. The MPI version matches the original serial program's output at 1–8 ranks, and the timed loop scales close to linearly.\n\n**Verification**\n- Built cleanly with no warnings, out of tree in `/tmp`.\n- Compared against the original serial binary on 7 configs (including `-v -r`, odd sizes, `-n 1`, and `-m 2.5`) at 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, and 8 ranks. Everything except the timing lines matched exactly: matrix size, nonzero count, the `-r` sums, samples, and hash, and the `-v` PASSED/FAILED result. Exit codes matched too.\n- Timing at `-n 8192 -s 10 -i 50` on one node, with the reported time being the slowest rank: 519 ms at 1 rank, 270 at 2, 130 at 4, 65 at 8, 32 at 16 (about 16× speedup). That is single-node only; I have not tested across nodes.\n\n**Design choices**\n- **Row partitioning:** rank `r` owns a contiguous block of rows, with the first `dim % P` ranks taking one extra row. Each rank stores only its own column indices and values, plus a replicated dense vector, which is O(dim) per rank.\n- **Exact RNG reproduction:** the matrix pattern and values come from the same `rand()` streams as the serial program, so results match bit-for-bit. Each rank runs the full generation pass but keeps only its share. This generation is not in the timed region, the same as the original. Its cost is O(dim²) `rand()` calls per rank, which will dominate wall time at very large sizes. Jump-ahead for the RNG would fix that, but it is a substantial change, so I did not attempt it.\n- **No communication in the timed loop:** the SpMV iterations need no messages because the vector is replicated. Timing uses a barrier before the loop and reports the maximum time across ranks.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. `-r` gathers the full output vector to rank 0 with `MPI_Gatherv`. `-v` checks each rank's rows locally, then combines the result with `MPI_Allreduce`, so every rank exits with the same code. Error messages still show global row indices."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":737,"cache_read_input_tokens":50670,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":737},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"81a9c8d4-1b36-4077-aaa0-db8e33bca884","uuid":"a3fb2d73-f5f7-4539-a97a-0b9c94d59a1e","timestamp":"2026-10-13T20:31:45.691Z","request_id":"req_011CfzsWYeEi3X9C35Twt4EB"}
